def paired_source_binding(self,call,name,obj):
        """The actual R522 stage receipt is source metadata, never a compile result."""
        if name!="stages":return None
        path=call/"owner"/"final-components"/name/"compile"/"paired-digit-source-binding.json"
        label=call.name+"/"+name+"/main/R522-source-binding"
        value=self.get(path,label)
        result=dict(compiler_site="main",actual_binding_file=self.files[label],
            source_preparation_binding_returned=value is not None,
            compiler_execution_or_success_not_inferred_from_preparation=True,
            returned_process_records=[])
        if not isinstance(value,dict):return result
        # This object consists of explicit sources/argv/flags and their original
        # receipts, not state, Jacobian, ledger or numerical witness arrays.
        # Retain the whole source binding once; actual process rows only refer
        # to it. A missing returned row is not an invented successful compile.
        result["paired_digit_compile_source_binding"]=value
        for index,row in enumerate((obj or {}).get("lifecycle",[])):
            observed=row.get("paired_digit_compile_source_binding")
            if not isinstance(observed,dict):continue
            result["returned_process_records"].append(dict(lifecycle_index=index,
                complete_binding_equals_file=canonical(observed)==canonical(value),
                process=keep(row,("started","reason","returncode","actual_process_returncode",
                    "wall_timeout","elapsed_seconds","actual_wall_allowance_seconds",
                    "requested_cap_seconds","pid","pid_start_time","stdout","stderr"))))
        return result
